name: smwgraphics-soul-blazer-battle-with-deathtoll
title: Soul Blazer - Battle with Deathtoll
description:
The background seen in the final battle of Soul Blazer, a cult classic video game made by Quintet.

The parallax scrolling was made by TheXander, but also has parts of Darolac's code in it, so credit both of them, if you use the bundled asm file.

If you want to lower the background, you must edit the parallax tables at the end of the asm file.

A good fit for climatic boss battles or sky levels.
